  "claims": [

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Finalized PSBT responses clear input fields under BIP 174, allowing signatures with unsafe sighash types like SIGHASH_NONE to bypass FindUnsafeSighashType undetected.",
      "quote": "I made the new mock return a finalized response and `FindUnsafeSighashType` doesn't catch it.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the code to reject finalized PSBTs and added a test case",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5866547937",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3957608371",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Whether returning a v0 PSBT should have a separate error message or whether the external signer must return the matching PSBT version.",
      "quote": "Worth a separate message, or does the signer have to return the version it was given?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that a constraint was added requiring matching versions",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4120178964"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4120178964",

    },

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add single-input test transactions for ECDSA and taproot so each FindUnsafeSighashType branch is exercised independently.",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a test case",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4120178775"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4120178775",
      "status_by_quote": "Added a test case."
    },

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add tests pinning behavior for a changed v2 input sequence and a corrupted signature",
      "quote": "the new tests cover the cases in my tACK except two: a changed v2 input sequence and a corrupted signature. In both the wallet's transaction stays as it was and `walletprocesspsbt` returns an incomple",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author added the requested test cases and reviewer confirmed they pass and fail when protections are disabled",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6392393108"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6397202873",
      "status_by_quote": "The two new cases are the ones I suggested, and each fails when its protection is removed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4493267593",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Emit a warning instead of rejecting when an unsafe sighash type is detected, letting the signer handle it",
      "quote": "imo it feels a bit stringent to REJECT this. Is leaning towards a warning possible, and let the signer determine how to handle it?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author pointed out GUI limitations and lack of use cases, and reviewer dropped the suggestion",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4526067978"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4530194132",
      "status_by_quote": "Again looking great as is, no strong opinion"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:7142498603",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "If a PSBTv2 input omits PSBT_IN_SEQUENCE, an external signer can inject a modified sequence that gets accepted and merged without detection.",
